notes: Optical characteristics specified at TOP = 0 to 70°C; electrical characteristics at TOP = -10 to 85°C. Supply VCC 3.0 to 3.6 V; features cite single 3.3 V supply and low power <750 mW. Product selection variants FTLF8519F2GNL, FTLF8519F2MNL (implied G/M/K/H grounding/EMI shield options). General Specifications Data Rate table lists Max 10500 Gb/sec (likely typographical; Typ values 1.062, 1.25, 2.125 Gb/sec). Receiver sensitivity at 1.0625, 1.25, and 2.125 Gb/s; stressed receiver sensitivity also given in mW (0.055 at 1.0625 Gb/s, 0.096 at 2.125 Gb/s) and -13.5 dBm at 1.25 Gb/s per FC-PI-2 conformance. Extinction ratio 9 dB specified at 1.25 Gb/s. Reach depends on fiber type and data rate (500/300 m on 50/125 μm MMF; 300/150 m on 62.5/125 μm MMF). Copyright/footer identifies Coherent Corp. (2023).
